session.summary: User is planning a beginner vegetable garden in their backyard, focusing on suitable vegetables, supplies, layout, planting schedule, and pest control for a zone 7b climate.

records.title: Beginner Vegetable Garden Project Plan
records.content: This record outlines the plan for starting a small vegetable garden in the backyard, including layout, supplies, and initial thoughts on planting and pest control.
records.description: A comprehensive project plan for a beginner's vegetable garden with sections for layout, supplies, and initial planning.

sections.heading: Garden Layout
sections.content: Planning a small garden bed of 4 feet by 8 feet, as it's considered a good size for beginners. The selected location receives about 6 hours of sunlight daily, which needs verification for sufficiency for most vegetables.

sections.heading: Supplies Needed
sections.content:
- Soil
- Containers or raised bed materials
- Seeds (tomatoes, lettuce, others TBD)
- Basic gardening tools
- Watering system (considering simple drip irrigation)

sections.heading: Initial Planting Thoughts
sections.content: Considering tomatoes and lettuce as they are beginner-friendly. Interested in companion planting, such as basil near tomatoes. Aiming to have everything planted by early May.

sections.heading: Pest Control
sections.content: Concerned about pests like rabbits in the neighborhood. Planning to explore fencing options and natural pest deterrents instead of chemicals.

records.title: Planting Calendar for Vegetable Garden
records.content: A reference calendar for planting schedules of various vegetables in the garden, to be updated with specific dates and vegetables based on zone 7b climate.
records.description: A dedicated reference for the planting calendar to track when to plant each vegetable throughout the season.

sections.heading: Planting Schedule
sections.content: To be populated with specific vegetables and planting dates for zone 7b climate. Aiming for completion by early May.
